notes: AUDIT CORRECTION: the dense/sparse flag on the tensor rows was inverted. FP16 165 / INT8 330.5 TFLOPS are the DENSE values (sparse = 2x). These rows were previously flagged dense:false, which wrongly told a reader they were sparse.  The stored numbers are correct dense values. Tensor Core figures are WITH SPARITY (sheet marks '*'): TF32 165 sparse / 82.5 dense, BF16+FP16 330 sparse / 165 dense, INT8 661 sparse / 330.5 dense. FP64 5.2 and FP32 10.3 are dense. A30 is the memory-rich inference part: 24GB HBM2 at only 933 GB/s and half-rate FP64 vs A100, so it is a bandwidth-per-watt and capacity part, not a FLOPS part. MIG profiles are asymmetric (4x6GB / 2x12GB / 1x24GB), which differs from A100's 7x10GB. NVLink is third-gen bridge-only, 2 GPUs at 200 GB/s. The 'other' row is FP64 5.2 TFLOPS (dense) - this schema's precision enum has no fp64 member.
